# opnsense_nginx_upstream_server (Resource)

nginx upstream servers (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ Upstream ▸ Upstream Server**, plugin `os-nginx`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_nginx_upstream_server" "app1" {
  description = "app1"
  server      = "10.0.10.21"
  port        = 8080
  priority    = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description.
- `port` (Number) Port.
- `priority` (Number) Server Priority.
- `server` (String) Server.

### Optional

- `fail_timeout` (Number) Fail Timeout. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `max_conns` (Number) Maximum Connections. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `max_fails` (Number) Maximum Failures. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `no_use` (String) Do Not Use. One of `down`, `backup`. Defaults to ``.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx upstream server.
